entities.summary: Die Burger is a daily Afrikaans-language newspaper, published by Naspers. In 2008, it had a circulation of 91,665 in the Western and Eastern Cape Provinces of South Africa, but by 2025 its print circulation had declined to just to 29,173. Along with Beeld and Volksblad, it was one of three broadsheet dailies in the Media24 stable, though Beeld and Volksblad ceased print publication in December, 2024.
